entities.summary: Voice of India (VOI) is a publishing house based in New Delhi, India, that specialises in Hindu nationalist books and serves as an important tool in the propagation of Hindutva. Voice of India is a publishing house in Asia, established in 1949. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
